integrity: Full analytic proof and a standalone standard-library exact-rational checker are included; no independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Equal isotropic coordinate mobility, symmetric uniform pair coupling, positive harmonic pinning, and strictly positive independent Langevin bath temperatures are essential stated hypotheses.

Rank two concerns stationary probability-current field image and integrated current tensor; the nonzero tensor eigenvalues are not stochastic generator relaxation eigenvalues or physical angular velocities.
Pairwise heat flow is represented mathematically; its attribution to individual physical bonds is not uniquely determined by reservoir heat exchanges.
The entropy-production divergence is a limit of strictly positive temperatures at fixed first two bath moments, not a finite-temperature singularity.
The result has same-model verification, not independent scientific validation or certified historical priority.
title: One collective circulation plane with unbounded dissipation in a fully connected multibath Brownian network
